t: When the one who wronged you walked away from it
a: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
p: Wa lā taḥsabanna-llāha ghāfilan ʿammā yaʿmalu-ẓ-ẓālimūn…
m: And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
